scope: Synthetic visibility and wayfinding stressors for the counterfactual V6 experiment. They are not a CFD fire reconstruction, a reconstruction of the building's installed lighting, or evidence of observed occupant response.

smoke.cue_assumption: Conservative reflecting-directional-cue convention. Do not represent this as the installed exit-sign type.
smoke.implementation_boundary: Smoke must enter the V6 runner only through an explicitly registered, time-stamped route-visibility field and route-cost audit. It must not alter physical DiSFM parameters, uptake C, or an unmeasured human compliance probability. The three fixed values are predeclared stress-test anchors, not measured building smoke conditions.

nominal.meaning: Code-context reference only; this project has no photometric survey of the building.

outage_50pct.assignment: For each scenario environment seed, choose an exactly half-sized set of registered virtual wayfinding markers by a seeded permutation; for an odd number of markers, floor(n/2) are unavailable and the realized count is logged.
outage_50pct.meaning: A stylized wayfinding-marker outage stressor, not a claim that 50% of actual building luminaires fail.

emergency_lighting.implementation_boundary: Virtual markers may be attached only to registered route-decision portals after geometry acceptance. Nominal emergency lighting does not prove actual code compliance or installed illumination.

pairing.environment_seed_stream: Use the existing paired environment_seed. The same smoke field and marker availability assignment must be reused at every uptake C within a scenario, A1 set, and replication.
pairing.prohibited: Do not resample environmental state by uptake condition or use it to recalibrate the V5 physical core.

source_basis.citation: NIST FDS-SMV Manuals, current FDS documentation
source_basis.use: Optical extinction/visibility relation only; V6 does not claim to execute FDS.
Establishes that sign luminance and smoke conditions influence sign visibility; it does not calibrate V6 occupant behaviour.

source_basis.citation: NFPA 101, 2024, Sections 7.9 and 7.10; local licensed source copy
source_basis.use: Emergency-egress illumination and sign-visibility code context only; not a compliance determination for this building.
